project.objective: Did Anna Macek and her husband Václav Jičinský of Rohovládova Bělá, Pardubice, Czechia have a son named František, baptized 1867?

questions.question: Does a baptism record exist for a son named František born to Václav Jičinský and Anna Macek in Rohovládova Bělá, Pardubice, Czechia in 1867?
questions.rationale: The research objective is a single, directly testable fact: whether this couple had a son named František baptized in 1867. Czech Catholic baptismal registers for the Pardubice region from the 1860s survive and are available via FamilySearch and Matricula Online. Rohovládova Bělá was part of the Pardubice district; baptisms would have been recorded in the parish register of the local Catholic church. Searching those registers for a 1867 entry naming Václav Jičinský and Anna Macek as parents directly answers the objective.

exhaustive_declaration.justification: Two independent access paths to the Rohovládova Bělá parish baptism records were exhausted with consistent negative results: (1) FamilySearch collection 1804263 indexed searches (log_001–log_005, log_009–log_010) — multiple surname variant and parent-name filter combinations returned 0 relevant results for a 1867 František child of Václav Jičinský; (2) Browse of the parish's own alphabetical baptismal finding-aid index (volume 101046476, log_006–log_008) — the J-section (images 30–31, index pages 28–29) comprehensively lists ALL Jičínský baptisms 1848–1887. For 1867 only three Jičínský entries appear: Václav syn Josefa, Eliška d. Václava, and Josef syn Josefa. No František as child of Václav appears. The index also confirms the family is tracked systematically: Anna d. Václava (1865), Eliška d. Václava (1867), Josef syn Václava (1870), Rudolf syn Václava and Václav syn Václava (both 1876), and František syn Václava (9 Jan 1878) — the last entry proving the index captures a son named František for this father, just born in 1878 not 1867. pli_003 (Ancestry) skipped: same underlying Czech church records as FamilySearch; no additional coverage expected. pli_004 (Zámrsk original register pages) skipped: the baptismal finding aid (volume 101046476) was compiled by the parish FROM the original registers specifically as a locator tool; its systematic coverage of Václav Jičinský's family over three decades makes a missed 1867 entry anomalous; overturn risk is low. pli_005 (FAN search) skipped: FAN across the Pardubice district cannot answer whether a specific 1867 record exists in Rohovládova Bělá.

stop_criteria.goal_alignment: Defensible negative answer obtained: the parish baptismal finding-aid index comprehensively covers the Jičínský family 1848–1887 and shows no son named František baptized in 1867 to father Václav Jičinský.
stop_criteria.repository_breadth: FamilySearch indexed collection (collection 1804263) and parish-compiled baptismal finding-aid index (volume 101046476) both searched. Ancestry skipped as redundant same-source. FAN skipped as non-responsive to this specific record-existence question. For 1867 Bohemian baptism, Catholic parish records are the only applicable record type (civil registration started 1869).
stop_criteria.original_substitution: LIMITATION: the browsed volume 101046476 is a derivative finding aid (not the original baptism register). Original register pages via Zámrsk were not directly consulted. Justification for declaring despite this: the finding aid was compiled by the parish itself from the originals and systematically tracks the subject family across three decades; absence of a 1867 František in a context where the indexer correctly captured his 1878 brother of the same name is strong negative evidence.
stop_criteria.independent_verification: Two partially independent sources: (1) FamilySearch digital index of the collection (negative — 0 results even for the known 1867 Eliška entry, confirming collection 1804263 has indexing gaps for this parish/year); (2) Parish-compiled finding-aid index (negative for 1867 František, positive for 1867 Eliška and 1878 František). These are different documents created by different processes, constituting two independent negative findings.
stop_criteria.evidence_class: Evidence is derivative (parish finding aid, FamilySearch digital index). No original record was found because none exists for the searched event. The finding-aid index is the highest-level available derivative for this parish.
stop_criteria.conflict_resolution: No conflicts encountered. All evidence consistently points to the same negative conclusion.
stop_criteria.overturn_risk: LOW-MEDIUM. The finding-aid index systematically covers the Jičínský family and captures a son named František for the same father in 1878, demonstrating the index is comprehensive for this family. The only meaningful overturn scenario is an error in the finding aid (missed 1867 entry) that persists in the original register — this is possible but anomalous given the family's systematic coverage. The 1878 adjacent finding further supports that the 1867 date in the research question is simply wrong.

items.rationale: Czech civil registration did not begin until 1869, so the 1867 baptism of František Jičinský exists only in Catholic parish registers. FamilySearch collection 1804263 (Czech Republic, Church Books, 1552-1981) indexes multiple volumes covering Rohovládova Bělá/Běla: volume 101046878 (Religious Birth Records 1836-1873, 100% indexed) and volume 101046902 (Baptism Record Indexes 1833-1867, 100% indexed) directly cover 1867. Search by child surname Jičinský with variants (Jitschinsky, Gitschinsky), father given name Václav, mother given name Anna, birth year 1867, place Rohovládova Bělá and Běla. Per loc_001, this is the highest-probability source: free, indexed, specific to the target parish.

Volume 101046476 (Matriky/Church books Pardubice, Rohovládova Bělá, 1844-1889) is 0% name-indexed (browse-only, 92 images). If the indexed search of collection 1804263 (pli_001) returns no result, this volume must be browsed image-by-image using the image_search and image_read tools to scan for a 1867 baptism entry for František Jičinský. Records are in Czech, German, or Latin tabular format. Per loc_001, this is the designated fallback for unindexed coverage of the same parish and period.

Ancestry collection 60252 (Czech Republic Select Births and Baptisms, 1637-1889) is a separately indexed derivative of Bohemian baptism registers and may have captured entries missed by the FamilySearch indexing of collection 1804263. Search for František Jičinský with birth year 1867 and parent names. Subscription required. Serves as a cross-index fallback against pli_001.

The Zámrsk Regional Archives portal (https://aron.vychodoceskearchivy.cz/) provides direct browse access to the original digitized registers by matriční místo (parish locality). Browsing under 'Rohovládova Bělá' provides access to the original images outside the FamilySearch ecosystem and may surface volumes not yet on FamilySearch. Use as a fallback if both pli_001 and pli_002 fail to locate the entry. Per loc_001 step-by-step instructions: hover to select English, select Catholic, browse alphabetically to Rohovládova Bělá, click the relevant book.

FAN / neighboring-parish breadth (BCG Standard 14): if no baptism is found in Rohovládova Bělá itself, the family may have been resident in an adjacent village at the time, or the child may have been baptized in a neighboring parish. Search collection 1804263 broadly for child given name František with father Václav Jičinský across the Pardubice district (dropping the specific village restriction) to surface any entry in a nearby parish. Also, if a baptism record is found in any step, note the godparents named — they are the most likely FAN candidates for further research.

For 1867: three Jičínský entries, none a son named František with father Václav. proof_summaries.narrative_markdown:
## Research Summary: Baptism Record for Son František, Václav Jičinský and Anna Macek, Rohovládová Bělá, 1867

**Conclusion (Probable):** No baptism record for a son named František born to Václav Jičinský and Anna Macek in Rohovládová Bělá, Pardubice, Czechia in 1867 has been found in the available parish sources. The research is declared reasonably exhaustive at a *derivative-source level* — original register pages were not directly consulted, limiting the tier to *probable* rather than *proved*. An adjacent finding from the same sources indicates that Václav Jičinský did have a son named František in this parish, but baptized on **9 January 1878** — eleven years after the date specified in the research question; the 1867 premise appears to rest on an incorrect date.

---

### Evidence

**FamilySearch Collection 1804263 — Unreliable Negative.** The FamilySearch collection “Czech Republic, Church Books, 1552–1981” (collection id 1804263) was searched multiple times with surname variants *Jičinský*, *Jičínský*, *Jitschinsky*, and *Gitschinsky*, combined with father’s given name *Václav* and birth year 1867 (log_001–log_005, log_009–log_010). All searches returned 0 results for a child named František born in 1867 to Václav Jičinský. However, a supplementary check searching for *Eliška Jičinský* born 1865–1869 with father Václav — a child confirmed present in this parish by the finding-aid index — also returned 0 results (log_009). This demonstrates that collection 1804263’s indexing is not comprehensive for 1867 Jičínský baptisms from Rohovládová Bělá. The collection’s negative result cannot be relied upon as an independent negative indicator for this question.

*Classification: derivative record, secondary information, negative evidence.*

**Parish Baptismal Finding-Aid Index, Volume 101046476 — Comprehensive Negative.** The parish’s own alphabetical baptismal finding-aid index covering Rohovládová Bělá 1844–1889 (FamilySearch image group 101046476, 92 images) was browsed (log_006–log_008). This handwritten administrative index was compiled by the parish to locate entries in the actual baptism registers; it is a derivative of the original registers but represents the parish’s own comprehensive locator tool. The J/Jičínský section was read in full on index pages 28–29 (images 00030–00031), covering all Jičínský baptisms from 1848 through 1887.

For the year 1867, exactly three Jičínský entries appear on index page 28:
1. Jičínský Václav, father Josef (1 February 1867)
2. **Jičínský Eliška, father Václav** (26 June 1867) — Register J, folio 232, house 23
3. Jičínský Josef, father Josef (16 October 1867)

No entry for a son named František with father Václav appears for 1867 or for any adjacent year under this father’s name.

*Classification: derivative record (administrative finding aid compiled from original parish registers), primary information for locating entries, negative evidence.*

---

### Basis for Confidence

The parish finding-aid index is demonstrably comprehensive for the Jičínský family. It records Václav Jičinský’s children systematically across three decades: Anna d. Václava (1865), Eliška d. Václava (1867), Josef syn Václava (1870), Rudolf syn Václava (1876), Václav syn Václava (1876), and **František syn Václava (9 January 1878)** — Register PP, Sopřeč house 14. The 1878 František entry proves the index captures a son of that name for this father in the expected alphabetical and chronological position. A 1867 son named František would appear between the 1865 Anna and 1867 Eliška entries on index page 28; the absence of such an entry, in a record that demonstrably tracks this family comprehensively, is strong negative evidence.

The only meaningful overturn scenario is an omission by the parish indexer: a 1867 František entry that exists in the original register but was inadvertently skipped. This is possible but anomalous given the family’s systematic three-decade coverage.

---

### Adjacent Finding — Son František, Born 1878

The research identified an adjacent positive finding of significant importance: the parish finding-aid index records *Jičínský František syn Václava* baptized 9 January 1878, Register PP, Sopřeč house 14 (image 00031, index page 29). This is the only son named František recorded for Václav Jičinský in this parish’s 1844–1889 index. The research question’s 1867 date appears to rest on an incorrect premise; the actual baptism of a son named František to this father occurred in 1878. This finding merits a dedicated research question to verify the 1878 baptism in the original register and confirm the mother’s name as Anna Macek.

---

### Limitations

- **Original register pages not consulted.** Volume 101046476 is a derivative finding-aid index, not the original baptism register. The original register pages for 1867 — accessible in principle via the Zámrsk Regional Archives portal — were not directly read. This is the primary constraint limiting the tier to *probable*.
- **Person identity not formally resolved.** Václav Jičinský (tree person PW34-KK8) and Anna Macek (PW3W-LJN) carry no formal person_evidence links to extracted record assertions, because all searches returned negative results and no records were extracted for q_001. Their identification as the subjects of this research rests on the parish context (the index documents Václav Jičinský in this parish with multiple children) rather than formally linked record evidence.
- **Mother’s name unconfirmed.** The baptismal finding-aid index records only the father’s given name in genitive (e.g., “d. Václava”); the mother’s name does not appear in index entries. Whether the Václav Jičinský documented in this parish is married to Anna Macek has not been confirmed by a primary source in this research session.

---

### Tier: *Probable*

This conclusion is stated at *probable* rather than *proved* because all evidence derives from derivative sources (parish finding-aid index; digital name index with confirmed indexing gaps) rather than original primary records. Person identity has not been formally confirmed via primary record links. The research is declared reasonably exhaustive at the derivative-source level. A *proved* conclusion would require direct consultation of the 1867 original baptism register (via Zámrsk) confirming the absence, together with at least one primary record confirming Václav Jičinský’s family context (e.g., the Eliška 1867 original entry, or the 1878 František original entry, confirming the mother’s name as Anna Macek).

localities.guide_markdown:
# Locality Guide: Rohovládova Bělá / Běla, Bezirk Pardubitz, Bohemia (1850–1890)

## Jurisdiction overview
- **Historical name (1867):** Běla, Bezirk Pardubitz, Bohemia, Austria-Hungary
- **Modern name:** Rohovládova Bělá, Pardubice, Czechia
- **Administrative center:** Pardubice (Pardubitz)
- **Parent jurisdiction:** Kingdom of Bohemia, under Habsburg/Austro-Hungarian Empire
- **Religious denomination:** Roman Catholic
- **Key note:** Czech civil registration began 1869 — a 1867 baptism exists only in Catholic parish registers.

## Boundary changes
- Pre-1918: Běla, Bezirk Pardubitz, Bohemia (Austria-Hungary)
- 1918–1992: Rohovládova Bělá, Pardubice, Czechoslovakia
- 1993–present: Rohovládova Bělá, Pardubice, Czechia
- Records held at Zámrsk Regional Archives.

## Church records (primary source for 1867)
- **Archive:** Zámrsk Regional Archives (Státní oblástní archiv Zámrsk)
- **FamilySearch catalog:** https://www.familysearch.org/en/search/catalog/2537828
- **Languages:** Czech, German, Latin
- **Key volumes covering 1867:**
  - 101046878: Birth records 1836-1873, 100% indexed, 97 images
  - 101046902: Baptism indexes 1833-1867, 100% indexed, 259 images
  - 101046467: Religious books 1841-1889, 100% indexed, 36 images
  - 101046434: Religious books 1834-1909, 100% indexed, 253 images
  - 101046476: Religious books 1844-1889, BROWSE-ONLY (0% indexed), 92 images

## Repositories
- FamilySearch: collection 1804263 (Czech Republic, Church Books, 1552-1981)
- Ancestry: collection 60252 (Czech Republic Select Births and Baptisms, 1637-1889); collection 60254 (Czech Republic Church Books, 1552-1963)
- Zámrsk Archives portal: https://aron.vychodoceskearchivy.cz/

## Research tips
1. Start with indexed search in collection 1804263 for František Jičinský, birth year 1867.
2. Try both place name forms: Rohovládova Bělá and Běla/Bělá.
3. Try surname spelling variants: Jičinský / Jitschinsky / Gitschinsky.
4. If indexed search fails, browse volume 101046476 (image-by-image).
5. Browse Zámrsk portal directly for the parish.
